claims.claim_text: Materialise's manufacturing for patient-specific surgical guides, models and implants is registered with US FDA and operates under ISO 13485 / 21 CFR 820 quality management system; service centers subject to FDA inspections.
claims.subject: Materialise
claims.source_quote: We operate a certified quality management system in line with the U.S. Quality System Regulation, good manufacturing practice regulations and ISO 13485. We are registered with regulatory authorities in the United States, Europe, Canada, Australia and other jurisdictions. ... Our service centers are subject to periodic and sometimes unannounced inspections by regulatory authorities, including inspections by the FDA.

claims.claim_text: Materialise holds proprietary patented stereolithography curtain-coat (Mammoth) technology and other 3D-printing IP.
claims.subject: Materialise
claims.object_value: stereolithography / curtain-coat (Mammoth) and related 3D printing tech
claims.source_quote: We have proprietary stereolithography machines based on our patented curtain coat technologies. The original curtain coat machines had a medium sized build volume. These medium sized machines have subsequently been adapted to become the extra-large sized Mammoth machines.
